主要内容: Brookfield Asset Management Inc. filed Form 6-K with the SEC on September 13, 2017, including documents related to regulatory compliance and disclosures. The report was signed by Brian D. Lawson, the company's authorized representative. The company completed a C$300 million preferred share issue on the same date, with shares issued at C$25.00 per share and a cumulative quarterly fixed dividend of 4.75% annually for the initial period ending December 31, 2022. The offering was underwritten by a syndicate led by CIBC Capital Markets, RBC Capital Markets, Scotiabank, and TD Securities Inc. The dividend rate for Preferred Shares, Series 48 will be reset every five years at a rate equal to the greater of: (i) the 5-year Government of Canada bond yield plus 3.10%, and (ii) 4.75%. The shares will commence trading on the Toronto Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol BAM.PF.J. The shares may not be offered or sold in the United States or to U.S. persons absent registration or an applicable exemption from the registration requirements under the U.S. Securities Act. Securities explicitly mentioned in the source include Brookfield Asset Management Inc. (BAM).
